correctness.rationale: Proved F^3=F on undirected loopless graphs from antitonicity and x<=F²(x). For odd n, j->2j permutes sites and z_j=1-x_(2j-1) converts each output constraint to adjacent AND y’_j=z_j z_(j+1). A zero output counts independent cyclic sets Lucas_n; output all ones has one precursor; a single zero between ones is impossible; longer cyclic zero runs of length L have F_(L-1) internal independent-set assignments, which factor across runs. For nonconstant output, product <=F_(n-2); each nontrivial attractor union has at most 2F_(n-2)<Lucas_n+1 precursors. Independently exhausted every input/output for odd n=3..15 (n=15 has 32768 states), verifying all 2^n fiber equations. Infinite theorem rests on combinatorial run reduction, not only finite states.
